sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C11923, card C11923-K2, and 3 other card(s) linked by the same device profile (C03938-K1, C05595-K1, C05678-K1). Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, 1 online transaction(s) totaling $131.30 were identified as unauthorized: 3583368 ($131.30, 2016-12-29 03:27). The activity was detected through a customer report (Customer C11923 message: 'I never made this $131.30 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3583368.). The cardholder reported the activity as unauthorized. The transactions came from device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | ? | chrome 66.0 for android | ?'. The method of operation was online purchases from a single device profile shared across many unrelated cardholders, consistent with a coordinated ring. It is suspicious because device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | ? | chrome 66.0 for android | ?' was used by 4 different cards within ±14 days; near-identical amounts (mean $128.47, variation 2%) on one product code; the same purchaser/recipient email pair gmail.com / gmail.com on 100% of them; device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | ? | chrome 66.0 for android | ?' had never been used on C11923-K2 before; Vesta identity flag id_15 = New; Flagged $131.30 is above the card's 95th percentile (card history: 10174 txns, median $28.53, 95th pct $108.20, max $486.52). The bank opened internal case CASE-HHG-011, recommended blocking the card, and placed the linked cards under monitoring. Total suspicious amount: $131.30.
